# Project settings

Every setting of a Waycine project file (`.waycine.json`, schema version 1), as of
Waycine 0.1.1. This page is generated from the engine's settings catalog (`FIELDS`),
which also drives the web editor, validation, the
[JSON Schema](https://zhenyuanlu.github.io/waycine/schema/v1.json) and `waycine params`.

A project file only needs the settings that differ from the defaults. The file layout,
text tokens and versioning are described in [the project format](project-format.md).

## How to read this page

- **Setting** is the path in the JSON file. `layouts.*.` is one value per layout profile
  (`landscape`, `portrait`, `square`), `fonts.*.` one per font role (`display`, `body`),
  `stops[].` one per stop, `stops[].results[].` one per result line of a stop, and
  `stats.items[].` one per finale stat.
- **Default** is the engine default, rounded to four decimals (the JSON Schema has the exact
  values). Settings that differ per layout profile list each profile. `-` means there is no
  default: the value is optional or belongs to one stop or stat.
- **Range or options**: numbers outside the range are clamped when a project is loaded, and
  unknown options fall back to the default; either way the app and `waycine validate` say so.
- The first six sections are always visible in the web editor; the others open with
  "All settings".

| Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Du | Design unit: 1/1080 of the frame's shorter side, so 1 Du is 1 px at 1080p. |
| s | Seconds. Each duration becomes `max(1, round(seconds x fps))` frames. |
| frac | A fraction from 0 to 1 (of a segment, a phase or the frame, as the help says). |
| alpha | Opacity from 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque). |
| deg | Degrees of longitude or latitude (or of Mercator y for vertical nudges). |
| x | A multiplier. |
| px | Output pixels. |
| fps | Frames per second. |
| Mbps | Megabits per second. |
| chars | Characters. |

## Stops

Shown in the editor without "All settings" (some settings below only with it).

| Setting | Label | Default | Range or options | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stops[].id` | Stop id | - | text | Stable identifier of the stop, used by the app and in links. |
| `stops[].city` | City | - | text | Place name shown on the card and next to the pin. |
| `stops[].lat` | Latitude | - | -85.05 to 85.05 (deg) | Degrees north (negative for south). |
| `stops[].lon` | Longitude | - | -180 to 180 (deg) | Degrees east (negative for west). |
| `stops[].event` | Event | - | text | Line under the city on the stop card. |
| `stops[].date` | Date | - | date `YYYY-MM-DD` | Date of the stop (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `stops[].endDate` | End date | - | date `YYYY-MM-DD` | Optional last day; the card then shows a date range. |
| `stops[].dateText` | Date text | - | text | Free text shown instead of the formatted date, on the card and the pin. |
| `stops[].partner` | Extra line | - | text | Optional credit or partner line on the stop card. |
| `stops[].region` | Region | - | text | State or province as shown, for example MA; counted by the regions stat. |
| `stops[].regionCode` | Region code | - | text | Region key used to count regions, for example US-MA. |
| `stops[].country` | Country | - | text | Two-letter country code, for example US; counted by the countries stat. |
| `stops[].results[].medal` | Medal | - | `gold`, `silver`, `bronze`, `ring`, `none` | Medal drawn before the result and as dots next to the pin. |
| `stops[].results[].text` | Result | - | text | Result line on the card, drawn exactly as typed. |
| `stops[].results[].count` | Medal count | - | 1 to 5 | Number of medal dots next to the pin for this result. |
| `stops[].durationSec` | Stop length | - | 0.1 to 60 (s) | Overrides the stop length for this stop only. |
| `stops[].hidden` | Hidden | - | `true` or `false` | Leave this stop out of the video (no pin, route leg, card or stat). |

## Titles & text

Shown in the editor without "All settings" (some settings below only with it).

| Setting | Label | Default | Range or options | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text.title` | Title | `"MY JOURNEY"` | text | Shown at the start over the whole route. |
| `text.subtitle` | Subtitle | `"{stops\|STOP\|STOPS}  /  {km} KM"` | text | Line under the title. Use Insert to add live counts such as stops or kilometres. |
| `text.description` | Description | `""` | text | Optional extra line under the subtitle, for example your team or trip name; leave it empty to hide it. |
| `text.descriptionAt` | Show description | `"intro"` | `intro`, `introAndFinale` | Show the description only in the intro, or also at the end under the stats. |
| `text.kicker` | Stop label | `"STOP {n:02} / {total:02}"` | text | Small line above each city, for example STOP 01 / 07. |
| `text.uppercase` | All caps | `true` | `true` or `false` | Render titles, cities, events and labels in capital letters; result lines stay as typed. |
| `text.solid` | Solid text | `false` | `true` or `false` | Draw all text fully opaque, without fade-ins; shapes still fade. |
| `text.cardDate` | Card date format | `"YYYY.MM.DD"` | text | Date format on the stop card: YYYY, MM, DD, M, D and MMM are replaced. |
| `text.pinDate` | Pin date format | `"MM.DD"` | text | Date format next to each pin; leave empty to hide pin dates. |
| `text.rangeSeparator` | Date range separator | `" - "` | text | Text between the first and last day of a stop with an end date. |
| `text.pinDateJoin` | Shared pin date separator | `" / "` | text | Joins the dates of stops at the same place on one pin label. |

## Finale stats

Shown in the editor without "All settings" (some settings below only with it).

The default `stats.items` list is `STOPS` (`stops`), `COUNTRIES` (`countries`), `KM` (`km`).

| Setting | Label | Default | Range or options | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stats.show` | Show stats | `true` | `true` or `false` | Show the big numbers during the finale. |
| `stats.items[].source` | Stat | - | `stops`, `regions`, `countries`, `months`, `days`, `km`, `mi`, `custom` | What the number counts; custom shows your own value. |
| `stats.items[].label` | Stat label | - | text | Word after the number, for example STOPS. |
| `stats.items[].labelOne` | Label for one | - | text | Word used when the number is exactly 1, for example STOP. |
| `stats.items[].value` | Own value | - | text | Shown instead of the counted number (required for custom stats). |
| `stats.labelSize` | Stat label size | `52` | 1 to 400 (Du) | Size of the words after the numbers. |
| `stats.labelTracking` | Stat label spacing | `2` | -10 to 40 (Du) | Extra space between the letters of the stat labels. |

## Map grid & HUD

Shown in the editor under "All settings".

| Setting | Label | Default | Range or options | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `graticule.show` | Show grid | `true` | `true` or `false` | Draw the latitude and longitude grid. |
| `graticule.stepMode` | Grid spacing | `"auto"` | `auto`, `fixed` | Pick the spacing automatically from the zoom, or use a fixed step. |
| `graticule.fixedStep` | Fixed grid step | `0.25` | 0.01 to 90 (deg) | Grid spacing in degrees when the spacing is fixed. |
| `graticule.targetSpacing` | Grid target spacing | `63` | 5 to 600 (Du) | Automatic spacing aims for grid lines about this far apart. |
| `graticule.zoomSplit` | Grid refine zoom | `1.8` | 1.05 to 20 (x) | The grid spacing halves once the camera zooms in this far past the overview. |
| `graticule.maxSubdiv` | Grid refinements | `1` | 0 to 4 | How many times the grid spacing may halve as the camera zooms in. |
| `graticule.lineWidth` | Grid line width | `1` | 0 to 20 (Du) | Width of the grid lines. |
| `graticule.minorAlpha` | Minor line opacity | `0.0471` | 0 to 1 (alpha) | Opacity of unlabelled grid lines. |
| `graticule.majorAlpha` | Major line opacity | `0.1333` | 0 to 1 (alpha) | Opacity of labelled grid lines. |
| `graticule.labels` | Grid labels | `true` | `true` or `false` | Label the major grid lines with their degrees. |
| `graticule.clearLabels` | Keep grid labels apart | `true` | `true` or `false` | Leave out a grid label that would touch a corner mark or another grid label. |
| `graticule.labelSize` | Grid label size | `18` | 1 to 400 (Du) | Text size of the grid labels. |
| `graticule.labelAlpha` | Grid label opacity | `0.3529` | 0 to 1 (alpha) | Opacity of the grid labels (solid text ignores it). |
| `graticule.lonLabelOffset` | Longitude label position | `[5, 18]` | 2 numbers, each -400 to 400 (Du) | Longitude labels: distance right of their line, and distance from the top of the frame. |
| `graticule.latLabelOffset` | Latitude label position | `[18, 4]` | 2 numbers, each -400 to 400 (Du) | Latitude labels: distance from the left of the frame, and distance below their line. |
| `graticule.labelFormat` | Grid label style | `"plain"` | `plain`, `degree` | Plain (72W) or with a degree sign. |
| `hud.corners` | Corner marks | `true` | `true` or `false` | Draw the bracket marks in the corners of the frame. |
| `hud.cornerLen` | Corner mark length | `40` | 0 to 400 (Du) | Length of each arm of the corner marks. |
| `hud.cornerMargin` | Corner mark inset | `28` | 0 to 400 (Du) | Distance of the corner marks from the frame edges. |
| `hud.cornerWidth` | Corner mark width | `2` | 0 to 20 (Du) | Line width of the corner marks. |
| `hud.cornerAlpha` | Corner mark opacity | `0.4706` | 0 to 1 (alpha) | Opacity of the corner marks. |
